'''''Reload''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle on the Frontier]] campaign. During the campaign, then, [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] wanted to inspect [[XQ3 Platform|Platform]] ''[[NL-1]]'', which had its construction recently completed. He was in another transport when he came under attack by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces. He was protected by [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] armed with [[Advanced concussion missile]]s, one of which was piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]. The transport was present to reload Stele's Bomber with more missiles if he needed them.
